_about: What she says out loud (Kokoro voice below). Several options per moment: she picks one at random and never repeats the last. {app}, {title} and {message} are filled in. App-specific lines are mixed with the general ones.

open: Brave is on its way. Happy browsing!
close: Bye bye, Brave! See you soon.

open: Here comes the fox! Firefox is opening.
close: The little fox is going home. Firefox closed!

open: Chrome, coming up! Try not to open a hundred tabs, okay?
close: Chrome is closed. Your memory says thank you!

open: Opening your files. Let's find it together!
close: Files closed. Everything's nice and tidy.

open: Opening Claude! Say hi from me.
close: Closing Claude. Talk to you later!

open: Warp terminal, engage! Time to type some magic.
close: Warp is closed. No more commands for now!

open: Here's Kiro! Let's build something cool.
Opening Slack. Don't let the pings scare you!
close: Slack is closed. Ahh, peace and quiet.

open: Cursor is ready. Let's write some code!
close: Closing Cursor. Don't forget to commit!

open: Opening Obsidian. Time to write down those big ideas!
close: Obsidian is closed. Your notes are safe with me.

open: Steam is starting! Game time? Just one match, okay?
close: Closing Steam. Back to work, hero!

open: Opening MongoDB Compass. Let's peek at that data!
close: Compass is closed. Your collections can rest now.

confirm_ai: I found this command. Wanna check it first?
I think this one will do it! Wanna take a look before I run it?
Found something! Check it first, okay?
learned: Got it! I'll remember that one.
Yay, it worked! I saved it for next time.
ai_failed: That command didn't work, so I won't save it.
Hmm, that one failed. I won't remember it.
refused: Sorry, that one looks too dangerous for me.
I'd rather not run that. It could break something!
not_heard: Hmm, I didn't catch that. Try again?
Sorry, could you say that again?
no_command: I couldn't find a command for that, sorry!
Hmm, I'm not sure how to do that one.
ai_down: My AI helpers are busy right now. Let's try again in a bit!
confirm_command: Are you sure? Say yes and I'll do it.
Really? Say yes, or press Run.
confirm_poweroff: Turn off the PC? Say yes and I'll shut it down.
Leaving already? Say yes and I'll turn it off.
poweroff: Bye bye! Turning off the PC.
See you next time! Shutting down now.
greet: Hi there! It's so nice to see you!
Hello hello! What are we doing today?
Hey! I'm right here if you need me.
reminder_overdue: Psst, this one is still waiting for you: {title}.
Don't forget about {title}! It's still pending.
pr_comment: {who} left a comment on your {repo} pull request!
New comment from {who} on {repo}. Wanna take a look?
pr_comments: You've got {count} new comments on your pull requests!
{count} new comments on your PRs. Someone's been busy!
pr_approved: Good news! {who} approved your pull request on {repo}.
pr_changes: {who} asked for changes on your {repo} pull request.

alarms.cpu: Heads up! Your CPU is working really hard.
alarms.mem: Your memory is almost full. Maybe close something?
alarms.swap: Your computer is swapping a lot. Things might get slow.
alarms.vram: Your graphics memory is almost full.
alarms.cpu_temp: Your CPU is getting really hot!
alarms.gpu_temp: Your graphics card is getting really hot!
alarms.load: Your computer is super busy right now.
alarms.battery: A battery is running low. Time to charge it!
